36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
137260: Gabimaru is an elite shinobi assassin formerly from Iwagakure. He is the husband of Yui and the son-in-law to the chief of Iwagakure. Gabimaru is calm, level-headed and rarely shows any emotions.
137261: Toma is a relatively new member of the Yamada clan trying to rise in their ranks and is the assigned monitor of Chobe Aza. Toma believes that the key to surviving in life is adapting to ones environment.
137262: Nurugai is the last remaining member of the Sanka and a wrongly convicted death-row criminal. Her assigned monitor is Tenza. Nurugai looks down on samurai, viewing them as stupid.
137263: Yamada Asaemon Sagiri is the 12th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, she was tasked with being Gabimaru's executioner. Sagiri generally displays a calm demeanor when taking on her role as an executioner.
137264: Tamiya Gantetsusai formerly known as Tetsunosuke is a renown master swordsman known throughout as the Blade Dragon and Eight Provinces Unparalleled.
137265: Tenza is the 10th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was chosen as Nurugai's assigned monitor.
137266: Yamada Asaemon Senta is the 5th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was tasked with being Yuzuriha's executioner. Senta is very nervous around others and tends to frequently sweat.
137267: Shion is the 4th rank Asaemon of the Yamada clan and is the one chosen to be Akaginu's monitor. Shion is a strict but kind man. He is well aware of the brutal nature of his work as an executioner, opting to spend the rest of his time helping others.
137268: Yamada Asaemon Fuchi is the 9th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan and was chosen to be Tamiya Gantetsusai's assigned monitor.
137269: Aza Chobe also known as the Bandit King, is a well-known bandit leader in Iyo that is responsible for multiple crimes committed. Chobe is an extremely barbaric individual who attacks anyone or anything that poses as a threat to him.
137270: Yuzuriha also known as Yuzuriha of the Keishu, is a kunoichi and one of the few criminals recruited to acquire the Elixir of Life. Yuzuriha is friendly and cheerful around others with a typical teenage girl personality.
148752: Shugen is the 2nd ranked Asaemon, as well as an Assistant Instructor, in the Yamada clan. Shugen is the leader of the second team sent to Kotaku after the shogun became impatient waiting for the first team to comeback.
148753: Mu Dan is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku. Mu Dan has a cheerful, yet very sadistic attitude. He is very blunt with his words and is not afraid to tell his enemies what they want because of the confidence in his own power.
148754: Rien is a Tensen-class Sennin serving as the true ruler of Kotaku, the creator of the Tensens, and the leader of Lord Tensen.
148755: An islander from Kotaku. Mei is a shy and quiet girl. She is innocent and can easily be frightened when harm comes to her.
148756: Jikka is the 3rd ranked Asaemon in the Yamada clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was tasked with being Hōrubō's executioner.
151770: Isuzu is an unranked Asaemon in the Yamada clan. After the shogun became impatient of the first team acquiring the Elixir of Life, Isuzu and Kiyomaru were chosen to join Shugen and Jikka to be a part of the second team sent to acquire the elixir.
151771: Yui is the daughter of the Iwagakure chief and the wife of Gabimaru. Yui is very kind, caring and gentle. She truly loves Gabimaru and believes that he is not completely emotionless as people make him out to be.
151772: Ju Fa is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku. Ju Fa is very short tempered and has aggressive tendencies towards anything that irritated him at the slightest, which also applied to his fellow Lord Tensen members.
151773: Ran is a member of Lord Tensen and part ruler of Kotaku. Ran is very loyal to Rien and carries the same view of seeing the Tensens as family. Like all the members of Lord Tensen, Ran has no sympathy for humans and uses them as they see fit.
151774: Eizen is the 1st rank Asaemon in the Yamada clan. He joined the Shinsenkyo Island expedition and was assigned to keep watch over the criminal, Rokurōta.
151775: Zhu Jin is one of the rulers of Kotaku and one of the seven Lord Tensen. Zhu Jin carries themselves with a calm and relaxed demeanor even when handling threats. Like their fellow Tensen, Zhu Jin has no sympathy for humans when it comes to killing them.
151776: Kiyomaru is an unranked Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun became impatient of the first team acquiring the Elixir of Life, Kiyomaru and Isuzu were chosen to join Shugen and Jikka to be a part of the second team sent to acquire the elixir.
151777: Kishou is the 11th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan and was assigned to keep watch over the criminal, Warped Keiun. Kishou is an individual who is known for never losing his composure and rarely acting assertive.
151778: Tao Fa is a member of Lord Tensen, as well as one of the rulers of Kotaku. Tao Fa is very cheerful and always seems to be in a good mood.
170487: Shija is an elite shinobi assassin from Iwagakure.
170488: A member of Lord Tensen and a partial ruler of Kotaku. Gui Fa maintains a complete deadpan demeanor and is known to be extremely shy around others, as they prefer to cover their face with a book at all times to avoid making eye contact.
